```yaml
name: Bump personal server after release

on:
  release:
    types:
      - published

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: bump-personal-server-after-release-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    if: ${{ !github.event.release.prerelease && startsWith(github.event.release.tag_name, 'v') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
      PERSONAL_SERVER_REPO: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
      PERSONAL_SERVER_BASE_REF: main
      PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH: bump-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
      PERSONAL_SERVER_CONTROL_FILE: hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
      PERSONAL_SERVER_COMPOSE_FILE: hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
    steps:
      - name: Check out hushline-personal-server
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_REPO }}
          ref: ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_BASE_REF }}
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server

      - name: Check out or create release branch in hushline-personal-server
        working-directory: hushline-personal-server
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git fetch origin "$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH":"refs/remotes/origin/$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH"
            git checkout -B "$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH" "origin/$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH"
          else
            git checkout -B "$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH"
          fi

      - name: Update control file version
        id: update_control
        working-directory: hushline-personal-server
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Extract version from hushline/version.py
          HUSHLINE_VERSION=$(cut -d'"' -f2 ../hushline/version.py)
          
          # Update the version in DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s/^Version: .*/Version: $HUSHLINE_VERSION/" "$PERSONAL_SERVER_CONTROL_FILE"
          
          echo "Updated control file version to $HUSHLINE_VERSION"

      - name: Update docker-compose.yaml version
        id: update_compose
        working-directory: hushline-personal-server
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Extract version from hushline/version.py
          HUSHLINE_VERSION=$(cut -d'"' -f2 ../hushline/version.py)
          
          # Update the version in docker-compose.yaml
          sed -i "s/ghcr.io\/scidsg\/hushline:.*/ghcr.io\/scidsg\/hushline:$HUSHLINE_VERSION/" "$PERSONAL_SERVER_COMPOSE_FILE"
          
          echo "Updated compose file version to $HUSHLINE_VERSION"

      - name: Commit and push changes
        working-directory: hushline-personal-server
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "$PERSONAL_SERVER_CONTROL_FILE" "$PERSONAL_SERVER_COMPOSE_FILE"
          git commit -m "Bump hushline version to $RELEASE_TAG" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin "$PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH"

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server
          base: ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_BASE_REF }}
          head: ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH }}
          title: "Bump hushline version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          body: "Automated PR to bump hushline version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }} after release."
          commit-message: "Bump hushline version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          branch: ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_BRANCH }}
          delete-branch: true
          signoff: true
          add-paths: |
            ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_CONTROL_FILE }}
            ${{ env.PERSONAL_SERVER_COMPOSE_FILE }}
```
